title: RecordingModeType
enum: On Demand with User Initiated Start
description:
* `Always` - Call recording is always enabled.
 * `Never` - Call recording is never enabled.
 * `On Demand` - Call recording is started and stopped manually by the user.
 * `Always with Pause/Resume` - Call recording is always enabled with the ability to pause and resume.
 * `On Demand with User Initiated Start` - Call recording is started manually by the user.
